title: Activity files
responsibility: Separates currently uncommitted files from recent committed file changes.

inputs.name: ActivityFiles.files
inputs.description: Required committed changes with path, status, last-change commit/time and unit owners. Kept in supplied order.

inputs.name: ActivityFiles.worktrees
inputs.description: Required checkout snapshots or null. Null denotes unavailable live checkout state; an empty array or no changes displays no uncommitted changes. Includes truncation information.

inputs.name: ActivityFiles.href
inputs.description: Required callback forming a commit-page link for each committed file.

inputs.name: ActivityFiles.registry
inputs.description: Required wording identifying which revision’s registry supplied component ownership labels.

outputs.name: ActivityFiles
outputs.description: Uncommitted and committed lists with paths, status, ownership chips and commit links. Shows six entries initially in each list, with expansion controls. Counts changed files and checkouts, mentions truncation and distinguishes unavailable live state from empty lists. The data is displayed without querying Git.
